# Phone Number

## Summary
Base-realm phone number field (primitive string with phone-aware edit UI).
Lives at `https://cardstack.com/base/phone-number` (default export
`PhoneNumberField`).

## API
Primitive string — store the number as entered, country code included.

The module also exports `PhoneNumberType` (an indexed label such as
mobile/home/work) and `ContactPhoneNumber` (a compound of number + type)
for contact-book use cases.

## Usage
```ts
import PhoneNumberField from 'https://cardstack.com/base/phone-number';

@field phone = contains(PhoneNumberField);
```
